terra.problem: “Hadad Rises Against Solomon” does not establish where Hadad became Solomon’s adversary. The passage connects Hadad and Joab’s earlier campaign to Edom, but places Hadad in Egypt afterward.

“Water Comes from Edom” suggests the water shortage and miracle happened in Edom. The kings traveled by way of the Desert of Edom, but the passage does not identify the valley as being in Edom; the water came from its direction.
Some terms are above a fifth-grade reading level, especially “garrisons,” “subject to,” and “adversary.” Simpler wording would make the moments more accessible.
